notes: Monotype Connect APP + Plugin UI ingress triggers. Push: local/scripts/push_ui_testrail_cases.py --pack app_plugin --merge-map
preconditions_template:
1. Monotype Connect desktop app installed on macOS.
2. Valid test user credentials (PP: mem.auditpreprodtest@gmail.com · QA: mem.auditqatest@gmail.com).
3. App not logged in OR ready to re-open Preferences.

cases.title: Verify plugin panel opened (Plugin)
cases.custom_preconds:
1. Monotype Connect desktop app installed on macOS.
2. Adobe InDesign or Illustrator with Monotype Fonts plugin installed and enabled.
3. Valid test user credentials; Connect logged in.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open host app (InDesign/Illustrator) with Monotype plugin installed.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Document or start screen visible.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Monotype Fonts plugin panel (Window → Extensions / Monotype).
custom_steps_separated.expected: Plugin panel opens; pluginPanelOpened fires.

custom_steps_separated.content: On the test Mac open the latest log under ~/Library/Logs/Monotype/Monotype Connect/ConnectService/service, find the ingress curl for operation `pluginPanelOpened`, and copy xCorrelationId (field name xcorrelationid in the log).
custom_steps_separated.expected: Real correlation UUID captured; raw + enriched audit event verifiable in Generation Status.
